title: Collections Desk Reference: Bill Lines Tested with a Payment Arrangements Installment by Late Payment Record
content:
**Collections desk reference — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)**
**Bill lines tested with an installment, by the account's late payment record**

When an installment of an agreement is tested as missed, which bill lines of the tested billing period make up the current charges tested with it follows the late payment record of the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account. The record read is the number of late payment charges billed on the service account in the twelve months ending on the day the miss is recorded.

| Late payment charges billed on the service account in the twelve months ending on the day the miss is recorded | Current charges tested, from the bill of the tested billing period |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the usage lines, plus the service fees, plus the late payment charge billed for that billing period |
| at least 1 but fewer than 3 | the usage lines, plus the service fees billed for that billing period |
| none | the usage lines alone |

**Boundary of the ladder**

| Late payment charges in the twelve months | Lines tested |
|---|---|
| 0 | usage lines |
| 1 | usage lines and service fees |
| 2 | usage lines and service fees |
| 3 | usage lines, service fees and late payment charge |
| 4 | usage lines, service fees and late payment charge |

The count is taken across the whole service account, not only the bills that carried installments, and only the lines billed for the tested billing period enter the current charges.

**Hypothetical bill of the tested period:** usage lines $88.10, a service fee of $15.00 and a late payment charge of $6.00. With 2 late payment charges on the account in the twelve months, the current charges tested are $103.10; with 3, they are $109.10; with none, $88.10.
